path_options.label: Internal guarded English baseline only
path_options.why: PROD-059 makes the bounded English deterministic surface ready_with_exclusions, and this path does not cross any still-blocked legal, provider, voice, retrieval, public-demo, real-customer, payment, contract, German, or production boundary.
path_options.review_question: Should this bounded English surface become only an internal, local/offline synthetic regression reference while broader gates stay blocked?

path_options.label: Public demo path
path_options.why: Public demo use remains explicitly excluded by PROD-059 and needs its own public-demo, polish, safety, and legal review.
path_options.review_question: Is there any evidence that public demo use is ready now? PROD-060 records no such evidence.

path_options.label: Real customer path
path_options.why: Real customer use remains blocked; the current evidence is synthetic and local.
path_options.review_question: Should real customer calls stay blocked until a separate customer-use gate exists?

path_options.label: Provider or private-data path
path_options.why: PROD-059 did not approve provider calls, LLM use, or private-data reads.
path_options.review_question: Should provider/private-data work remain a separate explicit opt-in gate?

path_options.label: Retrieval default path
path_options.why: Runtime retrieval remains disabled by default and must reopen through RAG gates.
path_options.review_question: Should retrieval stay default-off for this path decision?

path_options.label: Voice playback path
path_options.why: Voice playback quality remains a separate listening gate and is not proven by English text readiness.
path_options.review_question: Should voice playback stay outside the English runtime path?

path_options.label: German language path
path_options.why: Native German review remains parked until the corrected reviewer export exists.
path_options.review_question: Should German exact-phrase promotion remain parked instead of folded into English readiness?

path_options.label: Payment or contract path
path_options.why: Payment collection and contract signing are legal/deployment actions, not runtime wording readiness.
path_options.review_question: Should payment and contract activity remain blocked until separate legal/deployment gates?

path_options.label: Production runtime path
path_options.why: Production runtime promotion remains explicitly blocked by PROD-059 exclusions.
path_options.review_question: Should PROD-060 reject production promotion until product-policy and deployment gates are resolved?
